description: A principal Boolean filter is proper exactly when its generator is nonzero.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.principal_filter_proper_iff.{u} {B : Type u} [BooleanAlgebra B] (a : B) :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.IsProperFilter (Order.PFilter.principal a) ↔ a ≠ ⊥
